entities.summary: Rohini Khadilkar is a chess player holding the title of Woman International Master (WIM). She has won the Indian women's championship five times and the Asian women's championship twice. She was the first female chess player to compete in the Indian Chess Championship in 1976, and the first to receive the Arjuna Award in 1980.
